unlinked.info: P99 Buff Lines carries an explicit warning that the page is incomplete for item-based buffs and for "+0 rows" (buffs that block a line without contributing to the stat). Legacy of Spike, Spirit of Scale, Pack Spirit, Pack Shrew and Spirit of the Shrew have no row on it.
Focus of Spirit (Shaman 60) and Mortal Deftness stack by developer accident only if Mortal Deftness is cast first - the page flags this as the one documented exception to the slot model.
Worn HP regeneration (Fungus Covered Scale Tunic, Aura of Battle items) stacks with spell regen but has a combined 15 hp/tick cap of its own.

Live Protection of the Glades carries hard-coded stacking blocks in its spell data ("Block new spell if slot 1 is effect AC and < 108", "... slot 2 Max Hitpoints and < 2486"), i.e. it refuses to be overwritten by weaker AC/HP buffs rather than relying purely on slot identity.
P99 flags Calefaction (Druid 44) as a trap purchase: ~80pp for barely more damage than casting Firestrike twice.

Live-only druid spells with no Legends counterpart that are not Luclin+ destination ports: Healing Water (DRU/34), Spirit of Ash (DRU/36), Spirit of Eagle (DRU/54), Tangle (DRU/50), Reebo's Augury/Cleansing/Exorcism line (DRU/11-34), Mass Imbue Emerald (DRU/29), Greater Mass Imbue Emerald and Greater Mass Imbue Plains Pebble (DRU/44), Eradicate Curse/Disease/Poison and Remove Greater Curse (DRU/54-58).

openQuestions: Legends has TWO rows for Skin Like Wood/Rock/Steel and for Shield of Thorns, and two differently-levelled rows for Skin Like Diamond (36/39), Skin Like Nature (46/49), Greater Healing (29/34), Invisibility versus Animals (8/9) and Improved Superior Camo/Camou (48/50). Are these genuinely two castable spells on the server, or duplicate scrape rows for one spell? The Diamond/Nature/Camo pairs look like a live-level row plus a classic-level row of the same spell.

Ring of South Ro appears twice: level 20 (teleports to South Ro) and level 25 (Group, but the coordinates are Butcherblock -2135,1984,3). The level-25 row is almost certainly a mislabelled Circle/Ring of Butcher. Needs a server-side check.
Protection of Wood on Legends prints "+10 to +15 AC", far above live (AC 3 at L9) and above its own single-target twin Skin Like Wood (AC 2-4). Likely a data error in the Legends description.

Legends Chloroplast scales to 16 hp/tick (L50) while Regrowth is a flat 15 hp/tick, inverting the classic strict upgrade (P99 lists Chloroplast at +10, Regrowth at +15). Same for Pack Chloroplast (16) vs Regrowth of the Grove (15). Is this intentional Legends re-tuning?

The Budding/Sprouting/Flowering/Blooming/Blossoming/Efflorescing Heal line has no classic or live counterpart at all - it is Legends-custom. Which buff slot (if any) does its hp/tick occupy, and does it stack with Regrowth?

Spirit of Oak grants +4 mana/tick on Legends but appears nowhere in the P99 mana-regeneration table (only in HP Regeneration Slot 3 & 6). Which mana-regen column does it use - does it block Clarity or Mask of the Hunter?

Legacy of Spike (49) is absent from the P99 Buff Lines page; its Damage Shield (Slot 1) placement here is inferred from Legacy of Thorn and from the identical +24 magnitude it shares with Shield of Thorns.

Legends druid levels below 34 follow live/modern Allakhazam exactly (Burst of Fire 3, Camouflage 4, Firefist 6, Thistlecoat 7, Skin Like Rock 14, Barbcoat 17, Resist Fire 20, Ensnare 26, Bramblecoat 27, Resist Cold 30...), while 34+ follows the classic 5-level cadence. Confirm whether the server intends the split.
